input.rationale: The Agreement contains no indemnification, defence or hold-harmless language anywhere: Section 9 (Warranties) is limited to corporate authority reps and the Globix carve-out, and Section 10 (General Provisions) has no indemnity. HDI therefore owes us nothing for third-party IP infringement claims arising from its design, development and hosting of the Site, or for its own breach of law, data breaches or gross negligence/wilful misconduct. That is walk-away territory under INDEMN (no Vendor IP indemnity at all), so we have inserted a Vendor indemnity at the preferred level after the warranty section, with standard notice/control/cooperation mechanics and a narrow reciprocal indemnity from us limited to Company-provided Content and our own breach of law. We have not added the fallback 3x-fees super-cap, which would only introduce a new limit on HDI's exposure in an agreement that currently has no liability cap.

proposal.summary: Insert an HDI indemnity (IP, breach of law, data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) with standard procedure and a narrow Company indemnity.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no indemnity at all, so we have added HDI's defence and indemnity for third-party IP infringement claims relating to the Site and HDI's services, HDI's breach of law, data breaches caused by HDI, and its gross negligence or wilful misconduct, together with the usual notice, control and cooperation mechanics. Our reciprocal indemnity is deliberately limited to Company-provided Content and our own breach of law.

ops.text: Indemnification. HDI shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless the Company and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Site or any services or deliverables provided by HDI infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (b) HDI's breach of applicable law; (c) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of the Company's data or Confidential Information caused by HDI; or (d) HDI's gross negligence or willful misconduct. The Company shall defend and indemnify HDI against third-party claims to the extent arising out of the Content provided by the Company or the Company's breach of applicable law. The indemnified Party shall give the indemnifying Party written notice of the claim, the indemnifying Party shall have control of the defense and settlement of the claim, and the indemnified Party shall provide reasonable cooperation in the defense.
